name: web-latex-mcp
description: Read, edit, compile, and commit LaTeX in a git-hosted project (Overleaf, GitHub, any git remote) — straight from Claude.
long_description: An MCP server that keeps a local clone of your LaTeX project, compiles it locally with latexmk (or tectonic), shows a live PDF viewer with review comments, and sends changes back through a reviewable commit → push. Add projects straight from the chat with register_project (no config editing), and store your git token in the OS keychain via credential_portal or set_credential — the token never touches this config file or the conversation.

overleaf_token.title: Overleaf Git token
overleaf_token.description: Optional. Your Overleaf 'Git authentication token', created under Account Settings → Git integration: https://www.overleaf.com/user/settings. Leave blank to add it later from the chat with credential_portal (entered on a local page, never in the chat).

github_token.title: GitHub token
github_token.description: Optional. A GitHub Personal Access Token (repo scope) if you work on GitHub-hosted projects. Leave blank to use the GitHub CLI, a credential helper, or credential_portal later.

workspace.title: Clone workspace folder
workspace.description: Optional. Folder to keep one local clone per project. Leave blank to use the default (~/.web-latex-mcp/projects).
